component.name: Mountie
component.summary: GUI to Mount and manage network shares

description.p: Mountie keeps your network shares in one place and mounts them with a single toggle. It handles SMB/CIFS, AFP, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV through GVfs without administrator access or fstab changes. An optional native SMB/CIFS backend uses a separately installed, narrowly scoped privileged helper.

ul.li: Add, discover, import, edit and remove network shares
Mount and unmount with one click, with status shown for each share
Ask for passwords each time or retain them in the system keyring
Optionally use the native kernel CIFS driver for higher SMB throughput
Each mounted share gets a short, stable path such as ~/Shares/Photos, instead of the long generated GVfs location
Light and dark themes, following the desktop's own preference and accent color by default

description.p: Mountie works on any desktop that provides GVfs and a secret service, including COSMIC, GNOME and KDE Plasma.

screenshot.caption: Every configured share with its connection status and local path
Configure the protocol, mount backend and network location
The interface follows your desktop's light or dark preference
